name: Microsoft SharePoint
certifications: Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102, covers SharePoint administration)
Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400, for SharePoint solutions with Power Platform)
Microsoft 365 Certified: Teams Administrator Associate (MS-700, related)

beginner.summary: For site owners, power users and new SharePoint administrators. Covers team and communication sites, pages and web parts, lists and libraries, columns and content types, views and formatting, permissions and sharing, versions and co-authoring, metadata and search, navigation and hubs, Microsoft Lists, Power Automate and Power Apps with SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive, templates and themes, retention and site lifecycle.
prerequisites: Uses Microsoft 365 apps such as Word, Excel, Outlook and Teams
outcomes: Build and run team and communication sites with pages, lists and libraries
Organise content with columns, content types, views and metadata
Automate simple processes with Power Automate and Power Apps

days.topic: SharePoint Overview, Sites and Course Setup
subtopics: What SharePoint is and how it fits with Teams and OneDrive
Roles: site owners, members and visitors
The SharePoint admin center at a glance
Microsoft 365 developer or trial tenant for practice
Course case company: an engineering consultancy
days.lab_task: Create a team site and a communication site in a trial tenant, explore site contents and settings and sketch the intranet for the case company.
days.deliverable: Two sites and an intranet sketch
checks: Main settings pages listed with purpose

subtopics: Text, image and file web parts
Hero and quick links web parts
days.lab_task: Build a home page for the communication site with a hero, quick links, news and highlighted documents, publish a news post on a schedule and save a page template.
days.deliverable: Home page, news post and template
checks: News post appears at the set time
Create a page from the template

subtopics: Opening files in the browser and apps
days.lab_task: Create a project documents library, upload files, sync it to a laptop, move files between libraries and restore a deleted file from the recycle bin.
checks: File back from the recycle bin

subtopics: Creating lists from templates and Excel
days.lab_task: Create an issue tracker from a template, import an asset register from Excel, add a rule that emails when an issue is high priority and add the list to Teams.
checks: Email sent for a high-priority issue

days.lab_task: Add site columns for project, client and document type, create a Contract content type with a template and validation and use it in two libraries.
days.deliverable: Site columns, content type and libraries

days.topic: Document Sets for Project and Case Files
subtopics: When to use folders or document sets
days.lab_task: Create a project document set with shared client and project metadata, default documents and a welcome page, create two project sets and capture a version.
days.deliverable: Document set content type and two project sets
checks: All files in the set updated

days.lab_task: Create views for my documents, contracts expiring this month and documents by client, colour-code status with conditional formatting and add a calendar view.

subtopics: Sharing links: anyone, organisation and specific people
days.lab_task: Set up owners, members and visitors groups, give a client view access to one folder, break inheritance on a confidential library and check a user's permissions.
checks: Open the folder as the client
Effective access shown for a user

subtopics: Approvals with Power Automate in brief
days.lab_task: Turn on major and minor versions, co-author a document with a partner, restore an older version and require approval before policies are published.

subtopics: Managed metadata and the term store
days.lab_task: Create a term set for services, tag documents with managed metadata, search with refiners and compare finding files by folders and by metadata.
days.deliverable: Term set, tagged library and comparison
checks: Time for folders and metadata recorded

days.topic: Navigation, Hub Sites and Site Structure
subtopics: Global navigation with Viva Connections in brief
days.lab_task: Create a hub for departments, associate three sites, build hub navigation with audience targeting and test it as two users.
checks: Sites share hub navigation and theme

days.lab_task: Build a flow that routes new contracts for approval, updates their status and notifies the team in Teams, and a manual flow that moves selected documents to an archive.
checks: Status updated and Teams message sent

days.topic: Custom List Forms with Power Apps
subtopics: Customising a list form with Power Apps
days.lab_task: Replace the issue tracker form with a Power Apps form that shows fields by issue type, validates input and works on a phone.

subtopics: How Teams stores files in SharePoint
Adding pages and lists to Teams
days.lab_task: Create a team, find its SharePoint site and channel folders, add a SharePoint page and list as tabs and write file storage guidance for staff.
checks: Folder found in the SharePoint library
Page and list open in Teams
Clear rules for OneDrive, Teams and sites

days.lab_task: Create a custom project site template with libraries and lists, apply a company theme and logo and create two new project sites from the template.
checks: Create a site from the template

days.lab_task: Apply a retention label that keeps contracts for seven years, declare a document as a record, try to delete it and find it in the preservation hold library.

days.topic: Site Lifecycle, Storage and Everyday Administration
days.lab_task: Review storage and usage for three sites, restore a deleted site, rename a site address and write a site owner checklist.

days.topic: Adoption, Training and Good Practices for Site Owners
days.lab_task: Audit a site for out-of-date content and accessibility problems, fix them, plan a training session and measure use before and after.
days.deliverable: Audit, fixes, training plan and usage comparison

days.topic: Using Copilot and AI with SharePoint Content
days.lab_task: Ask Copilot questions about site documents, check answers against the files, find a permission problem that exposes content and fix it.
checks: Answers match documents or errors noted
Content no longer returned for others

days.lab_task: Build a department intranet for the case company: a hub with sites, pages and news, libraries with content types and metadata, views, permissions, an approval flow, a custom form, retention and owner guidance, then launch it to test users.
days.deliverable: Intranet, flows, guidance and demo recording
checks: Test users' feedback recorded and acted on
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one intranet

intermediate.summary: For SharePoint administrators and developers. Covers the admin center in depth, information architecture, the content type gallery and term store, search, governance of permissions and sharing, SharePoint Framework web parts and extensions, PnPjs and Microsoft Graph, PnP PowerShell, provisioning, advanced Power Automate and Power Apps, migrations, Viva Connections, document protection, performance, SharePoint Premium, SharePoint Embedded and Copilot readiness.
prerequisites: Builds sites, lists, libraries and flows
outcomes: Administer and govern SharePoint at company scale
Build SPFx solutions and automate with PnP and Graph
Protect content and prepare it for AI

subtopics: Access control: unmanaged devices and idle sessions
days.lab_task: Configure tenant sharing and access control for unmanaged devices, restrict site creation, set storage limits and review active sites for problems.
checks: Open a file from an unmanaged device
Create a site as a normal user

days.lab_task: Run a card sorting exercise, design the information architecture for the case company's intranet and document sites, hubs, metadata and navigation.

days.topic: Content Type Gallery and the Term Store at Scale
days.lab_task: Publish company content types from the gallery to all sites, build term sets with synonyms and translations and change a term without breaking tagged documents.
days.deliverable: Content types, term sets and test results
checks: Tagged documents show the new name

subtopics: How search works in SharePoint Online
days.lab_task: Map custom columns to managed properties, create a vertical for contracts, add bookmarks for common queries and measure search success for ten test questions.
checks: Test questions answered in the top results

days.topic: Governance of Permissions, Sharing and Site Ownership
days.lab_task: Write a governance plan, require two owners per site, label confidential sites to block guests, run a sharing report and an access review of guest access.
days.deliverable: Governance plan, settings and review results

days.topic: Building Web Parts with the SharePoint Framework
subtopics: Development environment: Node.js, Yeoman and Gulp or Heft
days.lab_task: Build an SPFx web part in React that shows upcoming project deadlines from a list with a configurable property pane and deploy it through the app catalog.
days.deliverable: Web part code, package and deployed web part

days.topic: SPFx Extensions and Adaptive Card Extensions
subtopics: Adaptive Card Extensions for Viva Connections
days.lab_task: Build an application customiser that adds a company banner, a command set that sends selected documents for review and an adaptive card extension for the dashboard.

days.topic: PnPjs, REST and Microsoft Graph for SharePoint Developers
subtopics: Microsoft Graph for sites, lists and drives
Permissions for SPFx: API access requests
days.lab_task: Rewrite the deadline web part with PnPjs, add a Graph call for the user's recent files, batch requests and handle throttling.
Script reports of sites without owners and unique permissions, bulk-add a column to 50 libraries and run a weekly report from Azure Automation.

days.topic: Site Provisioning and Templates as Code
days.lab_task: Build a site request list, an approval flow and PnP provisioning that creates a project site with libraries, content types, permissions and labels.
days.deliverable: Request list, flow and provisioning template

days.lab_task: Build a multi-stage contract approval with parallel reviewers, update permissions with HTTP requests, handle errors with a scope and package the flow in a solution.
Build a canvas app for site inspections on a SharePoint list, handle delegation for large lists and write guidance on when to move to Dataverse.
checks: Use the app on a phone
Clear rules for SharePoint or Dataverse

subtopics: Migration sources: file shares, SharePoint Server and other clouds
SharePoint Migration Tool and Migration Manager
days.lab_task: Scan a file share, migrate it with Migration Manager mapping folders to libraries and metadata, run an incremental pass and validate counts and permissions.
days.deliverable: Scan report, migration report and validation

days.topic: Building an Intranet with Viva Connections
days.lab_task: Set a home site, configure global navigation, build a dashboard with cards and publish Viva Connections in Teams and mobile.
checks: Users see news for their group

days.topic: Protecting Documents: Sensitivity Labels and DLP
subtopics: Sensitivity labels for files and sites
Blocking external sharing of sensitive files
days.lab_task: Set a default confidential label on a finance library, block external sharing of files with card numbers using DLP and review alerts.
days.deliverable: Labels, DLP policy and alert review

days.lab_task: Fix a list over the view threshold with indexes and filtered views, speed up a slow page found with Page Diagnostics and enable the public CDN for assets.

subtopics: Prebuilt models for invoices and receipts
days.lab_task: Extract fields from invoices into columns with a prebuilt model, fill a summary column with autofill and generate contracts from a template with content assembly.
days.deliverable: Models, filled columns and generated documents

subtopics: Copilot and search in embedded apps
days.lab_task: Create a container type, build a small app that stores and lists files in containers through Graph and secure access per customer.

days.topic: Preparing SharePoint for Copilot and Agents
days.lab_task: Run oversharing reports, fix three sites, restrict discovery of a sensitive site, create a SharePoint agent for policies and set rules for who can create agents.
checks: Site content not returned by Copilot

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Company Intranet and Document Platform
days.lab_task: Design and build the case company's intranet and document platform: IA, provisioning, SPFx web parts and extensions, search, governance and labels, a migrated file share, Viva Connections and Copilot readiness, then launch it.
days.deliverable: IA document, solutions, scripts, migration report and launch recording
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For SharePoint architects and senior developers. Covers enterprise intranet architecture, multi-geo and large tenants, governance programmes, SharePoint Advanced Management, enterprise records, SharePoint Premium at scale, Copilot and agents architecture, SPFx at enterprise scale, SharePoint Embedded products, custom search with Graph connectors, integration architecture, oversharing at scale, large migrations, hybrid with SharePoint Server, throttling, accessibility, adoption, troubleshooting and platform strategy.
prerequisites: Has run migrations or intranet projects
outcomes: Design SharePoint architectures for large organisations
Govern content, records and AI at scale
Lead migrations, adoption and platform strategy

days.lab_task: Design an intranet for a 20,000-person company in five countries with hubs, multilingual pages, news and ownership, and defend the design.
Plan Multi-Geo for India, the EU and the US, move a site to another geo, check search across geos and plan for tenant limits.
Build a governance programme with policies, lifecycle rules, champions and measures, and review three months of governance data.
Turn on inactive and ownership policies, restrict a sensitive site with restricted access control, run site access reviews and read change history.
checks: Only the allowed group can open it

days.lab_task: Build a file plan for contracts and HR records, apply event-based retention, run disposition reviews and produce disposition evidence.
days.deliverable: File plan, labels and disposition evidence

days.lab_task: Roll out document processing to ten libraries, tag content with taxonomy tagging, monitor accuracy and cost and report value.
days.deliverable: Rollout plan, accuracy report and value report

subtopics: Agents built with Copilot Studio on SharePoint content
days.lab_task: Design agents for HR and IT policies with scoped knowledge, test answers against source documents, monitor use and set governance rules.
days.deliverable: Agent designs, tests and governance rules

days.topic: SPFx at Enterprise Scale: ALM and CI/CD
subtopics: CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
Deploying to the app catalog automatically
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that tests, packages and deploys SPFx solutions to the app catalog, share a library between solutions and upgrade SPFx versions.
checks: Solutions build on the new version

days.lab_task: Design a multi-tenant document product on SharePoint Embedded, build container management and permissions per customer and estimate cost.
days.deliverable: Product design, code and cost estimate
checks: Customers cannot read each other's files

days.topic: Custom Search with Microsoft Graph Connectors
subtopics: Search across Microsoft 365 and other systems
days.lab_task: Bring a line-of-business system into search with a Graph connector, set permissions, build a vertical and result type and check Copilot can use it.
days.deliverable: Connector, search configuration and test results

days.lab_task: Sync contract metadata between SharePoint and a CRM with webhooks and Azure Functions, handle throttling and monitor failures.

days.topic: Oversharing and Information Security at Scale
days.lab_task: Find sites shared with everyone, remediate them in bulk, find sensitive content with Purview, label it and report risk reduction.
Assess a SharePoint Server farm, plan waves, replace a SharePoint 2013 workflow with Power Automate, migrate one wave and validate it.

days.topic: Hybrid SharePoint with SharePoint Server Subscription Edition
subtopics: When SharePoint Server is still needed
days.lab_task: Configure hybrid search between a SharePoint Server farm and SharePoint Online and plan which workloads stay on-premises.
Run a bulk job that gets throttled, redesign it with batching and backoff, tune a slow intranet home page and monitor results.
days.deliverable: Redesigned job, page fixes and measurements

days.lab_task: Audit the intranet and an SPFx web part for accessibility, fix the issues with Fluent UI and run a usability test with three users.

days.topic: Adoption and Change Management for SharePoint
days.lab_task: Plan the adoption programme for the new intranet, set measures, run a champions session and review adoption data after a month.
Diagnose five injected issues (missing search results, a sync conflict storm, a broken SPFx web part, a failing flow and unexpected access), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review

days.lab_task: Write a three-year SharePoint platform strategy with roles, roadmap, investment case and value measures, and present it to a role-play leadership panel.

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise SharePoint and Content Platform
days.lab_task: Design and deliver a content platform for a multinational: intranet architecture, Multi-Geo, governance and records, oversharing remediation, SPFx solutions with CI/CD, connectors, AI content processing and agents, then present to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, solutions, governance reports and board presentation
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
